description: A two storey wooden medieval tavern seen from above with the roof removed so the interior shows: plank floor, long bar counter with shelves of bottles, round tables and chairs, a staircase; stone lower walls, a door and two windows on the front wall. Cozy medieval village pixel art, warm saturated greens, browns and wood tones, soft shading, crisp pixel clusters, thin dark outline, upper-left lighting, readable at native resolution. Isolated on a transparent background, no surrounding ground, no text.
